policy.objective: Maximize useful, scientifically diverse, comparatively affordable known-task coverage under the fixed source budget.
policy.cost_basis: Review steady control, native physical interval/horizon, cold/reset costs and allocated GPU count together. No universal per-control cutoff.
policy.data_budget_basis: Conservative sum of all named selected source files; shared train/eval copy; no compression/dedup accounting discount.
policy.publication_boundary: Resource membership and reviewed short-loop cost evidence; not a full CFD evaluator, paper-score reproduction or learned-policy benchmark result.
